using UnityEngine;
public static class FrameCheck { public static string Run() { return "frame=" + Time.frameCount + " unscaledTime=" + Time.unscaledTime.ToString("F3") + " realtime=" + Time.realtimeSinceStartup.ToString("F3") + " playMode=" + UnityEditor.EditorApplication.isPlaying; } }
